selected_primary_idea.title: SPECTRA-Loop: Spectral Partitioning, Energy Closure, Thermal Recovery, and Assurance
selected_primary_idea.summary: A boundary-aware PV-TPV research architecture that predeclares spectral routing, thermal interfaces, net electrical output, calibration, uncertainty, stability, and transfer conditions.
selected_primary_idea.scientific_object: converter architecture x source spectrum x optical partition x thermal boundary x load x measurement card x stability/transfer card
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: Boundary closure makes any hybrid PV-TPV efficiency comparison interpretable; a claimed net gain must survive a matched reference boundary, uncertainty budget, and stability condition.
falsifiers: gain erased by optical or auxiliary losses

competitive_ideas.title: Tandem-only absorber optimization
competitive_ideas.reason: relevant spectral route but incomplete thermal/system closure

high_risk_ideas.title: Thermoelectric tail-harvesting
high_risk_ideas.reason: could recover a gradient but may increase thermal resistance and accounting complexity

rejected_ideas.reason: conflates conditional device limit with universal physics and lacks a declared denominator

mcts_evolution.change: add assurance, uncertainty, stability, and transfer cards
